text:
Education is widely regarded as a cornerstone of economic progress. This essay will outline two principal ways in which schooling influences a country's development: by creating a productive workforce and by reducing the social costs that hold economies back.

First and foremost, education supplies the human capital that modern economies need. Employers in sectors such as engineering, healthcare and finance increasingly seek workers with advanced technical knowledge, digital literacy and sound judgement, and each additional year of schooling generally makes an employee more productive and better paid. As a result, businesses grow, tax revenues rise and governments can finance infrastructure and public services. In addition, educated citizens are more likely to start companies and develop new technologies, which creates jobs and attracts investment. Singapore, a small country with few natural resources, is often cited as a nation that built its prosperity chiefly on the quality of its schools and universities.

Beyond personal advancement, education also reduces costs that would otherwise drain public budgets. Educated individuals are statistically more inclined to make healthier lifestyle choices and less prone to criminal behaviour, which eases the burden on hospitals, police and prisons. Moreover, better-informed citizens are able to plan their finances, save for retirement and avoid long-term unemployment, so fewer rely on welfare. A community in which most residents have completed secondary school, for example, typically reports lower crime and healthier habits, leaving more public money available for investment.

To sum up, education drives economic development both by building a skilled, innovative workforce and by lowering the social costs of ill health and crime. For these reasons, it deserves sustained public support.

analysis.type_vi: Opinion dạng 'Discuss how X influences Y' → 2 cách ảnh hưởng

plan.step: 1. Nhận diện: cùng khung với đề 4
plan.think: 'Discuss how education influences economic development' là dạng 'role / influence' giống đề công nghệ. Dùng lại khung: mở bài báo trước 2 cách, mỗi thân bài một cách. Tách 2 cách ảnh hưởng không trùng nhau: (1) tạo lao động năng suất và đổi mới, (2) giảm chi phí xã hội.

plan.step: 2. Cách 1 — vốn con người và đổi mới
plan.think: Dùng lại ý kỹ năng → năng suất (đề 1) nhưng đổi góc nhìn sang kết quả vĩ mô: doanh nghiệp lớn lên, thuế tăng, chính phủ có tiền làm hạ tầng. Thêm ý mới 'khởi nghiệp và công nghệ mới' và ví dụ Singapore.

plan.step: 3. Cách 2 — giảm chi phí xã hội
plan.think: Ý quen thuộc từ bài mẫu của người học: giáo dục → khoẻ mạnh hơn, ít tội phạm. Biến nó thành lập luận kinh tế: giảm gánh nặng cho bệnh viện, cảnh sát, phúc lợi → có tiền đầu tư. Dùng khung 'Beyond personal advancement…' để chuyển từ cá nhân sang xã hội.
Tóm tắt 2 cách ảnh hưởng bằng hai danh từ song song (building … and lowering …), thêm câu ngắn kêu gọi đầu tư công.
